text:
Maya: quick heads-up 1 — NavHealth wants prescriptive "advisor" output for batching/caching/quant. target: p99 <120ms for short chats (avg 70-90 tokens) + ~40% cost drop. they asked for something ship-ready in 2 sprints. :wave:
Sam: paste the exact asks if you have them?
Maya: gist: 1) per-route config recommendations 2) small SDK helper that returns a config blob 3) safety modes for regulated routes 4) a way to surface expected cost/latency uplift. they want to pilot on 3 routes.
Ashley: 2 sprints is aggressive. propose split: Sprint 1 = advisor API + SDK + docs + basic telemetry; Sprint 2 = eval-triggered alerts + UI + policy tags.
Dmitri: agree. core engine (rule inference + API) is lightweight. eval alerts require eval infra + customer datasets which takes time.
Leo: list the minimal deliverables for sprint 1?
Maya: minimal: - advisor API (HTTP) that returns per-route advice - SDK helper (node/python) that calls API + single-line integration - advice surface: batching (time_window or size), cache hint (prefix TTL + sample keys), quant profile recommendation + fallback - confidence + estimated cost delta string
Sam: propose acceptance criteria: - API responds in <50ms avg for advice queries - example app + quickstart - telemetry events emitted for applied configs - 2 pilot customers onboarded and reporting before/after metrics within 2 weeks of applying advice
Ashley: add that the response should include a safety_label: ["safe","opt-in","disallowed"] so customers can auto-block aggressive configs on sensitive routes.
Dmitri: for quant recommendations include a guard: "regression_gate": "require_local_eval" and recommended rollback metric (e.g., perplexity delta or A/B threshold).
Maya: agreed. Sprint 1 can return recommended_profile and guidance text; Sprint 2 will include a small eval harness + automated alerts if regression gate triggers.
Sam: can we show a sample SDK response shape now?
Ashley: quick snippet:
```
{
  "route": "/chat/send",
  "advice": {
    "batching": {"strategy": "time_window", "window_ms": 8, "max_batch": 6},
    "cache": {"enabled": true, "prefix_ttl_s": 25, "sample_key_examples": ["system_prompt_v1"]},
    "quant": {"profile": "int8_mixed", "fallback": "fp16", "safety_label": "opt-in", "regression_gate": "local_eval"},
    "expected_delta": {"cost": "-38%", "p50_latency": "-20ms", "p99_latency": "+10ms"}
  },
  "confidence": "medium"
}
```
Dmitri: include an events schema: `advisor.suggested`, `advisor.applied`, `advisor.rollback` with fields for route, model_variant, before/after metrics. ops needs that to measure impact.
Leo: who will own pilots? I can coordinate with NavHealth, Rover.AI, and Newsly if that helps.
Maya: thanks Leo. Ash/Dmitri own API + telemetry infra. Sam will own launch criteria and tracking sheet.
Ashley: I'll draft SDK and docs. aim to reuse existing SDK patterns in devex repo.
Dmitri: I'll add runtime hooks: expose per-request token latency, kv-cache hit rates, and a flag surface to accept runtime batching knobs. runtime effort ~5 dev days.
product-bot: Please remember to gate pilot behind a feature flag and request opt-in telemetry consent from customers.
Sam: draft launch criteria (for product tracking): 1) advisor API + SDK published; 2) docs + example app; 3) telemetry events instrumented and validated; 4) 2 pilot customers onboarded with before/after p50/p99 + cost reports; 5) rollback plan and quant regression gate documented.
Maya: timeline proposal: Sprint A (2 weeks): API + SDK + docs + telemetry + 2 pilot onboardings. Sprint B (2 weeks): eval harness + alerts UI + policy tags + remaining pilot. plan for 1 buffer sprint for edge-case hardening. total 3 sprints.
Ashley: Risks: quant regressions, customers unwilling to run evals, runtime perf regressions from batching changes.
Dmitri: mitigations: conservative defaults (safe_label default = "safe"), require opt-in for aggressive quant, provide a small local eval script customers can run, telemetry to auto-suggest rollback.
Leo: blockers: need batching knobs in runtime (time-window scheduling vs strict size). status?
Dmitri: partial. we can expose knobs behind a flag; perf testing required. estimate 5 days for safe rollout.
Maya: immediate next steps: - Ash/Dmitri write short PRD section + acceptance tests - Leo draft pilot outreach email + onboarding checklist - Sam create tracking sheet and feature flag ticket
Sam: will post tracking sheet link here when ready and tag owners.
Maya: thanks everyone. let's aim to demo advisor + example app to NavHealth in 3 weeks. :rocket:
